product.definition: One H3 resolution-8 cell (~0.74 km²) on one UTC day with at least one active-fire detection. Histograms count cell-days by the exact set of platforms that detected fire there; an any-sensor count is a union, never a sum of detections.

staticSourceMask.rule: res-8 cells with >= 3 science-quality detections of FIRMS type 1 (volcano), 2 (other static land source) or 3 (offshore), making up >= 50% of the cell's detections across all SP sources and years

product.zeroMeaning: A zero is no matching records in the loaded data, never evidence that no fire occurred.

clip.source: US Census Bureau cartographic boundary (1:10M) via us-atlas@3
clip.rule: A detection belongs to the region iff the centre of its H3 res-7 cell (~5.2 km²) lies inside the boundary polygon; applied identically to archive and API rows.

product.areaCaveat: Region totals are clipped to the boundary polygon (coastal generalization of the boundary data applies). AOI queries include whole res-5 cells whose centres fall inside the AOI.

archive.note: FIRMS Archive Download (country polygon), split into API-plan windows. Verified row-identical to API windows on overlapping dates (scripts/ingest/compare-archive.mjs).
